description:
Create a solid 2mm-thick Z-bracket. The task starts with an open Z-profile sketch loaded. 

1. Switch to the Part Workbench.
2. Extrude the 'ProfileSketch' by 50 mm along the normal (Z-axis). Do NOT check 'Create Solid' (we want a surface first).
3. Use the '3D Offset' tool (Part > Offset) on the extrusion to create a solid body with 2 mm thickness. Ensure 'Fill offset' is checked to make it a solid.
4. Fillet the four sharp corner edges of the bracket (the short edges at the ends of the Z-shape) with a radius of 5 mm.
5. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/finished_bracket.FCStd'.
